text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Difference in mean level (percentage points of effective capacity) between month k of the series and the same calendar month a year later; where that falls in the fixed lockdown window the first later year outside it is used; for D15 and D18 the comparison month may fall as late as September 2026. Dotted lines: plus and minus 15 points.'
text.tspan: Difference in mean level (percentage points of effective capacity) between month k of the
series and the same calendar month a year later; where that falls in the fixed lockdown window
the first later year outside it is used; for D15 and D18 the comparison month may fall as late
as September 2026. Dotted lines: plus and minus 15 points.
